status_definitions.passed: All named checks are true and evidence is preserved.
status_definitions.failed: At least one named check is false.

gates.title: 111-card fixed-deck union and complete recursive closure have final audit rows
gates.note: The 1.5 matrix remains a historical structural baseline; these final rows merge the later executed audits.

gates.title: All applicable alternate modes and cost boundaries pass
gates.note: All 1,546 cost cases and 55 full-board mode cases pass.

gates.title: All applicable keyword sources and entry methods pass
gates.note: Printed, generated, copied, transformed, and evolved entry paths pass.

gates.title: Target, timing, capacity, and class-resource clauses have direct or generated tests
gates.note: Each closure card has at least one applicable scenario and direct test evidence.

gates.title: Runtime coverage has no unexplained untriggered clause
gates.note: not_triggered is never relabeled as runtime-passed: 443 clauses are separately explained by re-executed direct tests.

gates.title: Zero open P0 and P1 bugs
gates.note: All eight confirmed bugs are fixed with permanent regressions.

gates.title: Zero unsupported/placeholder, illegal mutation, and mask mismatch diagnostics
gates.note: No accepted matrix game exposed an unsupported behavior.

gates.title: At least 1,000 fixed-deck games finish without engine errors and replay by seed
gates.note: The saved matrix is 1,024 games, not a rounded 1,000 claim.

gates.title: Full unit, compile, and required smoke gates pass
gates.note: The final rules engine was frozen at b6f1d95; 1.13 and this gate add audit tooling only.
